subject: physics
question_text: What is greenhouse effect? Explain global warming.

verification.note: Asked in TS Inter I-Year Physics Paper-I, March 2023 (Q9) — Section A, 2 marks. The 1 + 1 mark split, one mark for each of the two parts asked, is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it; the question itself is sourced from that paper. Physics hand-checked: short wavelength solar radiation passes through the atmosphere, the Earth re-emits it as long wavelength infrared, which carbon dioxide and water vapour absorb and return to the surface; global warming is the extra rise in mean temperature caused by the added carbon dioxide.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The greenhouse effect
lines: Short wavelength radiation from the Sun
passes through the atmosphere and warms
The Earth sends it back as long wavelength
infrared, which carbon dioxide and water
vapour absorb and return to the surface.
This trapping of energy is the greenhouse
steps.margin_note: First mark. Both directions are needed: short waves in, infrared absorbed.
steps.why: The glass of a greenhouse behaves the same way, letting visible light in and holding the infrared inside. In the atmosphere carbon dioxide and water vapour do the work of the glass.
common_mistakes: Saying the atmosphere blocks the sunlight. It lets the short wavelength radiation in and absorbs the long wavelength radiation going out.

recall.must_convey: That short wavelength sunlight enters, the Earth re-emits infrared, and carbon dioxide and water vapour absorb it.

steps.memory_tip: Short wavelength in, long wavelength absorbed. Carbon dioxide is the absorber.

steps.label: Global warming
lines: Burning fuels adds more carbon dioxide to
the atmosphere, so more infrared is held
back and the average temperature of the
Melting ice and a rising sea level follow.
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Name the added carbon dioxide as the cause.
steps.why: The greenhouse effect itself is natural and keeps the Earth warm enough to live on. Global warming is the further heating caused by the extra carbon dioxide.
common_mistakes: Treating the greenhouse effect and global warming as the same thing. The first is natural; the second is the increase caused by the added gases.

recall.must_convey: That extra carbon dioxide from burning fuels raises the average temperature of the Earth.

steps.memory_tip: More carbon dioxide, more infrared held back, higher average temperature.

insider_note: The question has two parts, one mark each — define the effect, then say what raises it. Answering only the definition earns one mark.
